definitions.explanation: describing communication that avoids being direct, often to soften criticism or bad news

examples.japanese: {遠回|とおまわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{断|ことわ}った→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧。
{遠回|とおまわ}しな⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧はやめて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please stop speaking in a roundabout way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遠回|とおまわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}していた→批判する：21993_hihansuru⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
- ⟦{遠回|とおまわ}り→遠回り：14380_toomawari⟧ (detour, taking a long way)
- し (manner suffix)
→ "in a roundabout manner"

USAGE:
- {遠回|とおまわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say indirectly)
- {遠回|とおまわ}しな⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧ (indirect expression)
- {遠回|とおまわ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (to decline indirectly)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{遠回|とおまわ}し communication is common in Japanese culture, especially when giving negative feedback or refusing requests. Being too direct can be seen as rude or inconsiderate of others' feelings.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直接的|ちょくせつてき}→直接的：06093_chokusetsuteki⟧ (direct)
- ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (straightforwardly)
- ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (candidly)
